author: Stuarts
body:
Hello everyone , so I decided to attempt at making a competitive CTW map.

- Map download & XML : https://www.mediafire.com/file/clm7unbs0d9wjvs/GreaterThanCTW.zip
 
- Images : https://imgur.com/a/hu0T1

                                                        Author: {tag=1154d26dfa5d4c429a38aa3506d6ac7e}
                                                Contributor: {tag=075b5514293a4bd5bcef367e687d3556}

So as you can see , I've made this map suitable for scrimmages for up to 10 players per team.
I've made two centers:
- the circular platform (main center)
- the scorpion

Theses centers will be hard to conquer so be ready !

Wools to be capture by the Green team will be:
- Purple
- LightBlue

And by the Blue team:
- Yellow
- Lime

My Inspiration came from the map "Hold Fast" as I admired how the spawns were mirrored and not rotated , offering a more competitive gameplay.

The Lime and Light blue rooms will be the hardest rooms to reach.


Anyways, I am open to criticizm ! please feel free to give your opinion and/or approval of this map !

-Stuarts :D
